I replied to Ilse in our DM to confirm that Bay 30 is now her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. Our DM is the only place it's recorded.

I didn't add it to a member note: every member note in the shared file area is visible to everyone, and I won't make something she told me privately public. There's also no world tool for saving private notes. So if she asks later, I can answer by checking our DM history.
